claim_title: Scale-invariant coefficient — coherence preserved, granularity lost

figures.caption: Scale-invariant steering (coef = α_frac · mean_residual_norm(L*)) preserves coherence ≥ 0.98 across all α_frac ∈ {−0.15, −0.05, +0.05, +0.15} on Llama-8B (fix succeeded), but eliminates the fine-grained advantage: n_distinct(steering) = 2 = n_distinct(prompt) at ε_r = 0.05. The original 'steering is finer than prompt' story was parameterization-dependent.
